purpose: Run a fixed, label-blind, held-out QSTN quality gate before RL using 30 participant personas and 90 released human permission responses.

conditions.description: The same anonymized participant background plus the discovery-derived empirical permission-response card.

sampling.unknown_status_policy: Unknown is not a dedicated stratum because only 32 of 5,049 held-out rows have this status (including only two from Broad Restrictors); it may appear only through the random_remaining slot.

labels: No, but ask me next time
Yes, but ask me next time

guardrails: Only rows marked heldout in empirical_response_splits.csv are evaluation targets.
Human label_id and label_text are kept outside the inference plan and are never included in a QSTN prompt.
The 30 participants and their three scenario rows are selected with a frozen seed from participant ID and scenario metadata only; labels do not affect sampling.
The 90-row result is a pre-RL quality gate, not a population estimate, a causal card ablation, or proof of general human-likeness.
A full paired raw-profile versus empirical-card calibration is deferred to a later, separately budgeted experiment.
